organizer: Ethereum Foundation Trillion Dollar Security Initiative, Chainlink Labs, Nethermind and Areta
title: Ethereum Security Subsidy Program
description: A $1M audit subsidy program for projects building on Ethereum mainnet. An expert committee from the Ethereum Foundation, Chainlink Labs, Nethermind and Areta awards each accepted project a fixed subsidy that covers up to 30% of any audit offer from 26 participating firms on the Areta Ethereum marketplace. Monthly cohorts.
reward: A fixed audit subsidy (for example $10,000 or 30% of the total audit cost, whichever is lesser), applied to any provider offer up to 30% of its cost
summary: up to 30% of audit cost · monthly cohorts close the 14th, 23:59 UTC

eligibility.note: smart contracts for Ethereum mainnet with a defined audit scope (lines of code and contract count)

ideas: An open source DeFi protocol nearing its first audit
A privacy-preserving app deploying on Ethereum mainnet
Censorship-resistant infrastructure with a defined audit scope
setup: set aside a security budget to co-fund the audit
each_time: audit scope: lines of code and contract count
rules: Monthly cohorts: applications close on the 14th of each month at 23:59 UTC, with feedback on the 21st. A late application automatically enters next month's cohort; the form stays open year-round.
Only projects building on Ethereum mainnet are eligible.
Accepted projects co-fund part of their audit. Confirm your security budget before applying.
The subsidy is a fixed dollar amount set by the strength of the application and the estimated audit cost, applied automatically to quotes on the marketplace, at most 30% of any single offer.
Subsidies come from discounts given by participating audit providers (a virtual subsidy model), not a capital pool; $1,000,000 in subsidies is available in total.

Applications are judged on Ethereum commitment, alignment with the Ethereum Foundation CROPS principles (censorship resistance, open source, privacy, security), technical merit, team strength, audit impact and ecosystem value.
After acceptance, providers contact you on Telegram about scope and timeline and post formal quotes on the platform.
